title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Section_4
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FBI case files (62-HQ-83894) regarding UAP/UFO reports, investigations, and correspondence between 1947 and 1949, including internal memoranda and reports on the 'flying disc' phenomenon. / This document is a collection of FBI case files (62-HQ-83894) regarding 'Flying Discs' and 'Unconventional Aircraft' from 1949, containing internal memoranda, correspondence, and reports on various sightings. / This document is a collection of FBI case files (62-HQ-83894) regarding UAP/UFO reports, including correspondence, newspaper clippings, and internal memoranda from 1947 to 1949.

incidents.summary: Police officers in Portland, Oregon, observed a bright, silvery, round object reflecting sunlight, which made a wide turn and disappeared to the south.
incidents.quote: observed the very bright reflection of the sun on some object which was apparently made of silvery metal

incidents.summary: A pilot and co-pilot of a DC-3 observed a dark, wing-shaped object near Bethel, Alaska, which they maneuvered to avoid.
incidents.quote: described the object as appearing to be some flying wing

incidents.summary: A witness in South Royalton, Vermont, reported seeing flying discs.
Seven to ten objects observed flying over a farm near Rockfield, Wisconsin, making no noise.
incidents.quote: flew directly over our house. He said they went like blue blazes

incidents.summary: Witness observed a high-altitude object leaving a vapor trail that did not change shape or direction.
incidents.quote: witnessed a strange sight in the sky traveling at a very high rate of speed

incidents.summary: A metallic object with wings and a gyroscope center was found in the desert near Lone Pine, California.
incidents.quote: object could be described as being 8' in diameter with wings about 4' long

incidents.summary: Multiple sightings of an aerial object reported across New Mexico, including El Paso, Albuquerque, and Roswell.
incidents.quote: Sighting of identical object reported at 2255Z 30 Jan 49 by aprx 30 people

incidents.summary: Photographs taken by William Presley of an unidentified object over Oak Ridge, TN, were evaluated by the Air Force and determined to be a result of film defects (water or developer drops).
incidents.explanation: Film defects (water or developer drops on the negative).
incidents.quote: This indicates that either a drop of warm water or a drop of developer struck the film

incidents.summary: Eastern Airlines pilot and co-pilot observed an unconventional, wingless, rocket-shaped object with windows over Montgomery, Alabama.
incidents.quote: This aircraft was reported to be of an unconventional type without wings and resembled generally a rocket ship

incidents.summary: Multiple sightings of unexplained phenomena near Los Alamos, New Mexico, by military and civilian personnel.
incidents.color: brilliant green, red, white, blue-white, yellowish green
incidents.quote: sightings of unexplained phenomena were made near Los Alamos by Special Agents

incidents.summary: Dr. Lincoln La Paz observed a green fireball phenomenon near Starvation Peak, New Mexico.
incidents.quote: There was an initial bright light (no period of intensity increase) and constant intensity

incidents.summary: Reports of flares or green fireball phenomena near Killeen Base, Camp Hood, Texas.
incidents.quote: what was at first thought to be a flare was seen approximately one-half mile north of Killeen Base

incidents.summary: Reports of aerial explosions and falling silver objects near Ogden and Logan, Utah, initially suspected to be B-29 practice bombing.
incidents.explanation: Probably caused by B-29 practice bombing.
incidents.quote: observed what appeared to be an explosion in the air accompanied by a flash of light

incidents.summary: Wade H. Harrison observed a brilliant, mirror-like object moving southeast over Fort Smith, Arkansas.
incidents.quote: observed a brilliant object moving in a southeastern direction

incidents.summary: Lt. Frederick W. Davis observed a reddish-white object with a fire trail near Killeen Base, Texas.
incidents.quote: lighted object about the size of a basketball, reddish white in color, followed by a fire trail

incidents.summary: Major William H. Parrott observed a solid mass object with a clicking sound near Merced, California.
behavior: maneuvered through an arc of turn
incidents.quote: object was observed blanking out stars in describing a flight path
incidents.size: four or five feet in diameter

incidents.summary: Eastern Air Lines pilots reported a wingless, black, cigar-shaped object with a fiery tail and square windows near Montgomery, Alabama.
incidents.quote: A gigantic plane without wings, black against the night sky, streaking through the heavens

incidents.summary: Multiple sightings of a 'flying floor lamp' or 'red ball of fire' reported over Atlanta, Georgia.
incidents.quote: The front end of it looked like a flying floor lamp—a fiery-red floor lamp.

incidents.summary: Sightings of a long, cigar-shaped object with a red nose and trailing smoke reported across Virginia and Tennessee.
incidents.quote: It looked like a long black cigar which was on fire

incidents.summary: Witness observed a small, angular object in the sky that changed shape and appeared to be on fire.
incidents.quote: its shape was angular, more like a piece of torn paper.

incidents.summary: Report of a fire caused by an object striking a roof, suspected by the complainant to be a military flare or flying saucer.
incidents.quote: an object had entered the roof of the building, caused an explosion
